name: Norman G. Dakin
bio: Norman G. Dakin of LaPorte, Indiana, a boyhood friend of the editor, called at the Cow Boy in May 1885 on his way back from Portland, Oregon, and reported stock looking well along the line. He called again in August and November 1885.

moments.label: Called at the Cow Boy returning from Oregon

mentions: N. G. Dakin of LaPorte, Ind., returning from a trip to Portland, Oregon., made us a pleasant call on last Sunday. He reports stock looking well all along the line. He is well please…
N. G. Dakin, an old boy-hood friend of the editor, called on us during our absence last week. We are sorry to have missed him.
Norman G. Dakin, a boy-hood friend of the editor, made us a pleasant call Tuesday night. He is travelling for the Bissell plow Co. of South Bend, Ind.
